title: Nanbeige 4.3 - 33B open model jo bade models ko takkar de raha hai
content:
Ek chhota sa open model aaya hai, aur coding benchmarks pe bade naamon ko peeche chhod raha hai.
Naam hai Nanbeige four point three, thirty three billion parameters.
Ise Nanbeige LLM Lab ne Hugging Face pe release kiya hai, Apache two point zero license ke saath.
Matlab aap ise commercial kaam mein bhi free mein use kar sakte ho.
Ab numbers dekho.
Terminal-Bench two point one pe, jo coding agents ko terminal tasks pe test karta hai, Nanbeige ne EIGHTY POINT NINE score kiya.
Qwen three point eight, twenty seven B ka score tha seventy three.
DeepSWE pe sixty five point five, versus forty two point five.
One important caution: these are THE LAB'S OWN NUMBERS. Independent tests abhi baaki hain.
Aur context window hai five hundred twelve thousand tokens.
Matlab ek bahut lambi codebase ya kai documents ek saath model ko de sakte ho.
Ab aap sochoge, itne models roz aate hain, isme khaas kya hai?
Khaas ye hai ki ye ek TEACHER MODEL hai.
Lab ka plan hai isse ek chhota three billion wala model banana, jo is ki skills seekhega.
Small models that run cheaply are where real products get built.
Maan lo aapki chhoti software company hai, aur aap apna code kisi bahar ki API ko nahi bhejna chahte.
Aise model ko aap apne server pe chala ke ek internal coding assistant bana sakte ho.
Toh use kaise karein?
Step one. Hugging Face pe model card padho aur license check karo.
Step two. Dhyan do, full weights lagbhag sixty six GB ke hain, toh ise strong GPU chahiye. It is not a phone model.
Step three. Apne ek real coding task pe isse apne current model ke saath compare karo. Benchmark nahi, APNA KAAM DEKHO.
Mera take simple hai.
Open models ka gap har mahine kam ho raha hai. Jo team aaj test karna seekhegi, wahi kal paise bachayegi.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
